name: paceva-garmin
description: Your own Garmin Connect data in Claude: sleep, HRV, Body Battery, stress and activities. Free, local, read-only.
long_description: Uses Garmin's Personal API key to read your own Garmin Connect data on your computer. Nothing goes through Paceva's servers: Claude talks to this extension, and the extension talks to Garmin. Create a key at https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken and paste it when Claude asks.

garmin_api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
garmin_api_key.description: Create one at connect.garmin.com › Settings › Personal API Key. Garmin shows it only once.
